_note: Very short single words: Google returned near-silence for the bare word, so it is sent with a full stop. Texts with a placeholder are sent as they should be read. "je … desto", "um … zu" and "ohne … zu" also carry IPA sound hints ("sounds"): without them Google read a French "je", an English "um" and "zu" as "su". (Every "…" is sent as "...": see synth.py.)
